hero_tagline: Copy and paste excited kaomoji: hyped, arms-up Japanese text faces bursting with energy. Click any face to copy it instantly.
intro: Excited kaomoji (also spelled kamoji) are high-energy Japanese-style text faces: arms up, eyes sparkling, and ready to burst. An excited kaomoji such as ヽ(>∀<☆)ノ or ٩(◕‿◕)۶ is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and chats. Browse by style below and click any face to copy it instantly. Whether you search "excited kaomoji" or "kaomoji excited," every face here is free to copy and paste.

sections.label: Cheering & Yay
sections.intro: Faces for shouting yay: a win, good news from a friend, or cheering someone on before a big day. \(^o^)/ is the plain keyboard version that works in any app, and ٩ and و on either side of a face are two fists punching the air.
